name: rolepay-video
description: Rolepay's hackathon pitch and demo videos (Remotion). Outside the pnpm workspace on purpose.

scripts.gif:readme: ffmpeg -v error -i out/readme-loop.mp4 -vf fps=12,palettegen=max_colors=128:stats_mode=diff -f image2 -y out/readme-palette.png && ffmpeg -v error -i out/readme-loop.mp4 -i out/readme-palette.png -filter_complex '[0:v]fps=12[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=none:diff_mode=rectangle[out]' -map '[out]' -an -loop 0 -f gif -y out/readme-loop.gif
scripts.stills: for c in Title:100 Problem:240 TrustModel:410 OwnBudgets:330 PreferredStablecoin:260 Funding:270 FourBeats:235 AiProposal:200 NeverPayTwice:165 Numbers:200 Architecture:220 WhyTempo:220 EndCard:120 Captions:60 LowerThird:90; do remotion still src/index.ts ${c%%:*} out/stills/${c%%:*}.png --frame=${c##*:} || exit 1; done
